mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 46 degrees near Harriet Park under a First Quarter moon. If you look to the west southwest over Mount Horeb at 5:44 PM, you can catch the ISS passing high in the sky as it travels toward the northeast near Home Depot.

The City of Verona has updated its municipal court procedures and notices. Residents are reminded that they can resolve non-mandatory citations online or by mail, while O W I tickets require a court appearance or contact with the City Attorney.
Enjoy live music at Bailey's Run today. Tomorrow, you can catch more music at Wisconsin Brewing Company or join a session of yoga at Insight Wellness.
In a notable call from October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old local man for an O W I after he was discovered unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor is the fan-favorite Mint Explosion. The store is currently open and will remain serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
